title: The Melting Clock at the Desert Station

breakdown.title: The Melting Clock at the Desert Station
breakdown.logline: A dreamer waits alone at a tiny train station in a comic-book desert, where time drips away like wax.

texture.value: comic book style with thick black outlines

breakdown.world_logic: It is a place outside normal time, where waiting is eternal and the impossible is simply accepted.

geography.value: a small platform in the middle of a vast desert

landmarks.value: bench, clock on a pole, train tracks

appearance.value: a clock on a pole, melting like wax; appearance melted, face distorted

moments.action: The dreamer stands on the tiny train platform in the desert, looking at the old man in a white suit sitting on the bench and the camel standing beside him.
moments.looks_at: the bench and the clock pole
moments.visual_point: the tiny platform surrounded by empty desert
moments.dream: a camel standing quietly next to an old man in a white suit

moments.action: The old man tells the dreamer the train is late, like it always is. He sits calmly with the camel beside him.
moments.looks_at: the old man and the camel
moments.visual_point: the old man's calmness as he speaks

moments.action: The clock on the pole melts, dripping down like wax. Its face distorts.
moments.visual_point: the melting clock, details of dripping metal

moments.action: A train whistle sounds far away, but no train appears. The old man and the camel do not react.
moments.looks_at: the horizon where the tracks disappear
moments.feeling: being stuck, waiting for something that never comes
moments.visual_point: the emptiness of the horizon, no train in sight

moments.action: The old man and the camel get up and walk off into the desert, away from the platform.
moments.visual_point: the two figures shrinking into the vast desert

moments.action: The dreamer remains on the platform, watching the old man and the camel get smaller in the distance.
moments.looks_at: the shrinking figures in the desert
moments.feeling: being left behind, unable to leave
moments.visual_point: the dreamer alone on the platform, small in the frame

words: It looked like a comic book, with thick black lines and flat colours. I was standing on this tiny train station platform in the middle of a desert.
There was an old man in a white suit sitting on the bench, and a camel standing next to him.
Just sitting there, completely calm. He told me the train was late, like it always was.
I looked at the clock. It was melting, dripping down the pole like wax.
No, they didn't seem to notice it. I heard a train whistle far away, but no train came.
Kinda stuck. Like I couldn't leave the platform. Then the old man and the camel got up and walked off into the desert.
I stayed on the platform, watching them get smaller. Then I woke up.
A stranger. I didn't know him.
Yeah, the melting clock. That's the part I keep going back to.
You got it right. That's exactly it.
Yes, I would.
The comic book panel. Bold outlines, flat colours, like I saw it.
That sounds about right. The dream didn't say much about it, so go with your guess.
Leave it as you've pictured it.
You got it right. Just one bench and the clock on the pole, the rest is sand.
It's okay. I don't have much to say about myself. Usually I'm not much of a talker.
Yeah, it looks wrong. The camel isn't in the picture.
No, there's still no camel. The old man, the platform, the clock, and me are there but the camel is missing.
Okay.
It looks right.
Alright. Looking forward to seeing them.
It looks right. The clock is dripping down like that.
Okay.
It looks right. The old man is there with the camel, calm.
Okay.
Yes, it does. You can't see the train, just emptiness beyond the tracks.
Alright.
It looks right. They're walking away, getting smaller.
Okay.
It looks right. I'm still there, watching them fade.
